findings.value: A two-floor bar on Curtain Road in Shoreditch with a basement room. Its music is vinyl-only, with a Wednesday vinyl session and free Thursday DJ sessions listed.

evidence.quote: covering two floors in the heart of Shoreditch
Vinyl only with the emphasis on hearing great music from various genres, never too loud.

findings.value: The venue describes itself as a place for dates, catching up with friends and meeting new people.

evidence.quote: A place perfect for meeting for a date, catching up with your friends

findings.value: Vinyl-only DJ sessions: a Wednesday vinyl LP playback and cocktails night, and free Thursday DJ sessions.

evidence.quote: Weds Vinyl LP playback & cocktails sessions
Strictly Vinyl free Thursdays DJ sessions
